title: Anjali Prajith

He was low birth weight, and I was very worried about his health. The doctors and nurses supported me emotionally during that challenging time, and with their care my baby became healthy. Thank you to the entire team for standing with me.

My second delivery was especially memorable. When I went into labour unexpectedly, you quickly understood the situation and managed everything with calm reassurance. Thank you so much for your care and support. Best wishes for your future plans.

title: Jini Sibeesh

Even though I was diabetic and had a history of pregnancy loss, your care made the journey calm and tension-free. Your treatment, the way you handled everything, and your classes helped me so much. I will always be thankful to you for helping me welcome a healthy baby.

paragraphs: Both of my sons came into this world under the caring hands of Dr. Jyothi Mary Ma’am. I have no words to express my gratitude for the quality of care I received. title: Lismi.

Her guidance—especially recommending prenatal yoga and breathing exercises—played a key role in helping me have a smooth, normal delivery of my baby boy.

As a first-time mom, I navigated this journey with accurate information, consistent activities, a nourishing meal plan, and gentle postnatal exercises that supported my healing. I’m deeply thankful for the care and knowledge I received—it made all the difference.

After a pregnancy loss the previous year, I was anxious—but Ma’am made this journey easier and stress-free, with only the necessary medicines and minimal investigations.
We truly understand how genuine you have been and how you stood with our family throughout my pregnancy. We thank God for you and will always remember you in our prayers.
